name: Canada
description: Canada is a federal parliamentary constitutional monarchy and the world's second-largest country by area. A Commonwealth realm with English-French bilingualism, it combines vast natural-resource endowments with an advanced services economy deeply integrated with the United States. Key sectors include energy, mining, forestry, banking and technology, under a decentralized federal system.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Canada's actor space from Hudson's Bay fur-trade enterprise and railway nation-building through crown corporations to energy majors, chartered banks, and provincial innovation agencies.

works.title: Resource and Trade Corridor Network
works.description: Network analysis of oil sands, mining flows, rail-port corridors and cross-border supply chains tying provincial resource basins to US and Asian markets.

works.title: Federal Provincial Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of ten provinces and three territories, equalization transfers, and the jurisdictional split over resources, health and education.
